# TDPdf v2.2.0.0

**Password-protected PDFs open and stay protected, safer redaction, better printing, signatures you can see before you place them, and a search that doesn't freeze.**

## Password-protected PDFs

- A PDF with separate "open" and "owner" passwords now opens with the open password. Before, typing it failed with "owner password required".
- Saving a password-protected PDF keeps its password and permissions. Before, every save wrote it unprotected. Use **File > Remove Password** when you want the protection gone.
- TDPdf can only write RC4 encryption, so a file protected with AES is saved with 128-bit RC4 protection. The status bar tells you when this happens.
- Some protected PDFs that failed to open, or opened with garbled details, now open correctly.

## Redaction

- Redaction now also removes the hidden copies of what you covered: descriptions kept for screen readers, page thumbnails, private editor data, and bookmark titles that contain the removed text. If any of them remain, TDPdf does not write the redacted file.

## Printing

- **Reverse order**, and a choice of **long edge** or **short edge** for two-sided printing.
- **Actual size** and **Shrink oversized pages** scales. The print window remembers your scale and two-sided choice.
- Copies, page range, odd/even pages and reverse order have their own **Pages to print** section.
- Long documents print without using gigabytes of memory.
- If TDPdf can't prepare the open document for printing, it asks before printing the last saved version instead of doing it silently.
- Settings you choose in your printer's own **Properties** dialog (stapling, hole punch, trays, finishing) still carry through to the job.

## Signatures and forms

- Placing a signature shows a faint copy under the pointer. Turn the mouse wheel to resize it before you click, or press Esc to cancel. Saved signatures can be picked with the keyboard.
- If your saved-signatures file is damaged, TDPdf keeps a backup of it and tells you, instead of replacing it with an empty list.
- Form fields that share a name stay the same on every page. Esc cancels typing in a field, and AltGr characters type normally.
- Undo after a page change no longer empties form fields you had typed into.
- If a field can't be saved, TDPdf names it after the save.

## Saving and exporting

- **Save Flattened** shows its progress and can be canceled with Esc. Scanned pages keep their own resolution instead of dropping to 150 DPI.
- **Export Pages as Images** asks before replacing files that already exist, and a failed export keeps your old files.

## Search and dialogs

- Search runs in the background, so typing doesn't freeze large documents. It also finds words written with ligatures (fi, fl), soft hyphens, or hyphenated across a line break.
- Message boxes and password prompts follow the app size you've chosen.

## Installing

Managed machines update through Intune automatically; nothing to do. Otherwise it's the same self-contained `TDPdf.exe`.
